intervals.label: operating (commissioning through T2K-I)
intervals.note: ND280 was operational for the beamline commissioning run beginning in 2009; the instrumentation paper does not give an exact installation date.
intervals.quote: T2K began accumulating neutrino beam data for physics analysis in January 2010.

intervals.label: ND280 upgrade installed (Super-FGD, two High-Angle TPCs, TOF)
intervals.quote: By October 2023, three new types of detectors have been installed.

intervals.label: operating with the upgraded near detector
intervals.quote: The T2K Collaboration has started data taking using the enhanced neutrino beam and new neutrino near-detectors from December 2023.

name: ND280 (T2K off-axis near detector)
notes: Total detector mass and per-subsystem masses were not stated in the fetched sources; the T2K ND280 Upgrade TDR (arXiv:1901.03750) was consulted only via its abstract in this session.

placements.note: Off-axis position, 280 m from the target, in the near detector pit.

description.quote: tracking planes of scintillating bars alternating with either water target/brass foil or lead foil
description.value: Tracking planes of scintillating bars alternating with water-target/brass or lead foil, at the upstream end of the magnet.

description.quote: three time projection chambers (TPCs) and two fine grained detectors (FGDs) consisting of layers of finely segmented scintillating bars
description.value: Three gaseous time projection chambers interleaved with two fine-grained scintillator-bar detectors (FGDs), used to reconstruct charged-current interactions.

description.quote: Surrounds the PØD and the tracker
description.value: Surrounds the P0D and the tracker to detect gamma rays escaping the inner detectors.

description.quote: return yoke of the magnet is instrumented with scintillator to measure the ranges of muons that exit the sides
description.value: Scintillator instrumenting the return yoke of the magnet, measuring the range of muons exiting through the sides.

summary.plain: A stack of detectors inside a recycled particle-physics magnet, sitting just 280 metres from where T2K's neutrino beam is made. It measures the beam before the neutrinos have had a chance to change type, so physicists know what they started with.
summary.technical: Off-axis near detector in the recycled UA1 0.2 T dipole magnet: P0D, three TPCs and two FGDs as the tracking/target region, an ECal shell, and SMRD scintillator in the magnet yoke. Upgraded in 2023 with a Super-FGD and two additional high-angle TPCs plus time-of-flight planes.

technology.quote: the magnet recycled from the UA1 experiment at CERN
technology.value: Magnetized off-axis tracking detector: a water/brass Pi-Zero Detector (P0D), three gaseous time projection chambers and two fine-grained scintillator detectors as the tracker, surrounded by an electromagnetic calorimeter, all inside the recycled UA1 dipole magnet instrumented as a side muon range detector (SMRD).
